comments.text: I started a plumbing company and don’t have an hourly rate, i don’t even give free estimates i will do a service call and give a flat rate, total price for a job and credit the service call towards said job. My time is not free, my skill is not free etc. I don’t want customers who just want the cheapest price. I use only the highest quality material and do things right. I bid my jobs so i can make sure they are done perfect i don’t rush through a job to get to the next i don’t pack the schedule. But my Plumbing company is not my main income actually it’s my retirement plan, i have three sons one in middle school one in HS it’s for them if college isn’t their gig. If they don’t want the plumbing company cool i will sell it i will have a great pension coming in, investments so whatever the $ plumbing company makes is just extra. If the customer is tough to deal with or i dont wanna do the job i tell them i cant do it or price it so its worth my time. You cant run a company and not generate a profit, you have to know your operation cost, if you do good work are honest you will have work guaranteed. I never do a job the cheap guy screwed up already will not touch it. Nothing worse than coming behind the lowest bid to do work the lowest bid guy made worse. Those jobs ain’t for me. My son in HS learned that we went to bid a job customer said he had other bids lower i told my son their price wasn’t possible the numbers didn’t make sense but he wanted to beat their bids i said ok you make the call, he sold the job we made pennie’s . But it was worth the learning experience for him he learned not every job is worth landing. Not every job is profitable and your business can’t be a charity. Really good friends, Grandparents, Elderly neighbors they are the only folks i will help out. Everybody else gets a fair (them & I) competitive price that makes sense. They can take it or leave it. I’d love to run plumbing calls free for everyone but real world don’t work like that.
